8
Mponkyerɛne pii ba
1 # Eks 5.1 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔ Farao nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ma me man no nkɔ nkɔsom me. 2Na sɛ woampene amma wɔankɔ a, hwɛ, mede mponkyerɛne bɛha w’asase nyinaa. 3Na asuo no bɛdɔre mponkyerɛne pii, na wɔafoforo aba wo fie ne wo dabekyire, wo mpa so, wo nkoa afie, wo nkurɔfoɔ mu, w’afononoo mu ne wo mmɔre nkodoɔ mu. 4Na wo ne wo manfoɔ ne wo nkoa nyinaa so na mponkyerɛne no bɛforo aba.
Mponkyerɛne no
5Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa wo poma no, na tene wo nsa wɔ nsubɔntene, asuasu, ne ntareɛ so, na ma mponkyerɛne mmra Misraim asase nyinaa so. 6Na Aaron tenee ne nsa wɔ Misraim nsuo so, na mponkyerɛne ba bɛkataa Misraim asase nyinaa so. 7#Eks 7.11 Na akɔmfoɔ no de wɔn asumansɛm no yɛɛ saa ara maa mponkyerɛne foro baa Misraim asase so. 8#Eks 8.28; 9.28; 10.17 Ɛnna Farao frɛɛ Mose ne Aaron kaa sɛ: Mompa AWURADE kyɛw na ɔnyi mponkyerɛne no mfiri me ne me man so, na mɛma ɔman no akɔ akɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE. 9Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Wo ara kyerɛ me da ko a ɛnkɔsie na mempa kyɛw memma wo ne wo nkoa ne wo man, na wɔnyi mponkyerɛne no mfiri wo ne wo fie so, na wɔnka asuo no nko ara mu. 10#Eks 9.14; 15.11 Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɔkyena. Na Mose kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ sɛ deɛ woaka no, na woahunu sɛ obiara biara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn. 11Na mponkyerɛne no bɛfiri wo ne wo fie ne wo nkoa ne wo man so; asuo no mu nko ara na wɔbɛka. 12Na Mose ne Aaron firii Farao anim kɔe. Na Mose teaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE wɔ mponkyerɛne a ɔde aba Farao soɔ no ho. 13Na AWURADE yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Mose kaeɛ no, na mponkyerɛne no wuwui, afie mu ne adihɔ ne wiram. 14Na wɔboaboaa wɔn ano akuakuo, na asase no so bɔnee. 15#Eks 4.21 Na Farao hunuu sɛ wanya ahotɔ no, ɔpirim n’akoma, na wantie wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.
Mfuturo danee edwie
16Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: Tene wo poma no bɔ asase so mfuturo na ɛnnane edwie wɔ Misraim asase nyinaa so. 17Na wɔyɛɛ saa, na Aaron tenee ne nsa de poma no bɔɔ asase so mfuturo, na ɛdanee edwie wɔ nnipa ne mmoa so. Na asase so mfuturo nyinaa danee edwie Misraim asase nyinaa so. 18#Eks 9.11 Na akɔmfoɔ no de wɔn asumansɛm yɛɛ saa ara sɛ wɔrema edwie aba, nanso wɔantumi. Na edwie no baa nnipa ne mmoa so. 19#Eks 14.25; 4.21 Ɛnna akɔmfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Nyankopɔn nsateaa nie. Na Farao akoma pirimii ara na wantie wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.
Nwansena pii ba
20 # Eks 5.1 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Tua anɔpahema kɔgyina Farao anim; berɛ a ɔrefiri adi aba nsuo no ano; na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ma me man no nkɔ na wɔnkɔsom me. 21Na sɛ woremma me man no nkɔ a, hwɛ, mɛma nwansena ahodoɔ aba wo ne wo nkoa ne wo man ne w’afie so, na nwansena no bɛyɛ Misraimfoɔ afie mu ne asase a wɔte soɔ no so amaama. 22#Eks 7.5 Na mɛhyɛ Gosen asase a me man te soɔ no nso da no, na nwansena no amma hɔ, na wode ahunu sɛ mene AWURADE wɔ asase nyinaa so. 23Na mede ɔhyeɛ bɛto me man ne wo man ntam; ɔkyena na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yi bɛba. 24Na AWURADE yɛɛ saa. Na nwansena a wɔdɔɔso pii baa Farao fie ne ne nkoa afie ne Misraim asase nyinaa so. Na nwansena no nti asase no so sɛee. 25Na Farao frɛɛ Mose ne Aaron kaa sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔdeɛ mma mo Nyankopɔn wɔ asase yi so. 26#Gye 43.32 Na Mose kaa sɛ: Ɛmfata sɛ wɔyɛ no saa, ɛfiri sɛ Misraim akyiwadeɛ na yɛde bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn. Hwɛ, sɛ yɛde Misraim akyiwadeɛ bɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ wɔn anim a, wɔrensi yɛn aboɔ anaa? 27#Eks 3.18 Yɛbɛnante nnansa kwan akɔ ɛserɛ so, na yɛakɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, sɛdeɛ waka akyerɛ yɛn no. 28#Eks 8.8 Na Farao kaa sɛ: Me deɛ, mɛma mo kwan na moakɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn wɔ ɛserɛ so, na akyirikyiri nko na monnkorɔ; mompa kyɛw mma me. 29Na Mose kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, merebɛfiri wo nkyɛn makɔ makɔpa AWURADE kyɛw na nwansena no afiri Farao ne ne nkoa ne ne man so ɔkyena; na nkontompo nko ara na Farao nntwa bio sɛ ɔremma ɔman no nkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE. 30#Eks 8.12 Ɛnna Mose firii Farao anim kɔ kɔpaa AWURADE kyɛw. 31Na AWURADE yɛɛ deɛ Mose kaeɛ no, na ɔyii nwansena no firii Farao ne ne nkoa ne ne man so; anka baako mpo. 32#Eks 4.21 Na Farao pirim n’akoma saa berɛ yi nso, na wamma ɔman no ankɔ.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔ Farao nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ma me man no nkɔ nkɔsom me. Na sɛ woampene amma wɔankɔ a, hwɛ, mede mponkyerɛne bɛha w’asase nyinaa. Na asuo no bɛdɔre mponkyerɛne pii, na wɔafoforo aba wo fie ne wo dabekyire, wo mpa so, wo nkoa afie, wo nkurɔfoɔ mu, w’afononoo mu ne wo mmɔre nkodoɔ mu. Na wo ne wo manfoɔ ne wo nkoa nyinaa so na mponkyerɛne no bɛforo aba.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa wo poma no, na tene wo nsa wɔ nsubɔntene, asuasu, ne ntareɛ so, na ma mponkyerɛne mmra Misraim asase nyinaa so. Na Aaron tenee ne nsa wɔ Misraim nsuo so, na mponkyerɛne ba bɛkataa Misraim asase nyinaa so. Na akɔmfoɔ no de wɔn asumansɛm no yɛɛ saa ara maa mponkyerɛne foro baa Misraim asase so. Ɛnna Farao frɛɛ Mose ne Aaron kaa sɛ: Mompa AWURADE kyɛw na ɔnyi mponkyerɛne no mfiri me ne me man so, na mɛma ɔman no akɔ akɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE. Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Wo ara kyerɛ me da ko a ɛnkɔsie na mempa kyɛw memma wo ne wo nkoa ne wo man, na wɔnyi mponkyerɛne no mfiri wo ne wo fie so, na wɔnka asuo no nko ara mu. Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɔkyena. Na Mose kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ sɛ deɛ woaka no, na woahunu sɛ obiara biara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn. Na mponkyerɛne no bɛfiri wo ne wo fie ne wo nkoa ne wo man so; asuo no mu nko ara na wɔbɛka. Na Mose ne Aaron firii Farao anim kɔe. Na Mose teaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE wɔ mponkyerɛne a ɔde aba Farao soɔ no ho. Na AWURADE yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Mose kaeɛ no, na mponkyerɛne no wuwui, afie mu ne adihɔ ne wiram. Na wɔboaboaa wɔn ano akuakuo, na asase no so bɔnee. Na Farao hunuu sɛ wanya ahotɔ no, ɔpirim n’akoma, na wantie wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: Tene wo poma no bɔ asase so mfuturo na ɛnnane edwie wɔ Misraim asase nyinaa so. Na wɔyɛɛ saa, na Aaron tenee ne nsa de poma no bɔɔ asase so mfuturo, na ɛdanee edwie wɔ nnipa ne mmoa so. Na asase so mfuturo nyinaa danee edwie Misraim asase nyinaa so. Na akɔmfoɔ no de wɔn asumansɛm yɛɛ saa ara sɛ wɔrema edwie aba, nanso wɔantumi. Na edwie no baa nnipa ne mmoa so. Ɛnna akɔmfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Nyankopɔn nsateaa nie. Na Farao akoma pirimii ara na wantie wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Tua anɔpahema kɔgyina Farao anim; berɛ a ɔrefiri adi aba nsuo no ano; na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ma me man no nkɔ na wɔnkɔsom me. Na sɛ woremma me man no nkɔ a, hwɛ, mɛma nwansena ahodoɔ aba wo ne wo nkoa ne wo man ne w’afie so, na nwansena no bɛyɛ Misraimfoɔ afie mu ne asase a wɔte soɔ no so amaama. Na Farao frɛɛ Mose ne Aaron kaa sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔdeɛ mma mo Nyankopɔn wɔ asase yi so. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
